title: Blocking text encoding error
evidence: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xeb in position 399962: invalid continuation byte
reproduction: Parse the frozen Git blob with the inventory builder
recommendation: Resolve or explicitly exclude the invalid source before review

title: Shared SQLite transaction can roll back another session
evidence: Thread B returned success but thread A rollback left zero persisted rows
reproduction: Run two coordinated transactions through one DatabaseConnection in separate threads
recommendation: Use a connection per transaction or context with explicit ownership and savepoints

title: Review audit always attributes actions to web_user
evidence: Workflow calls use the literal actor web_user even when session user is alice
reproduction: Submit review with a mocked workflow and a different current_user
recommendation: Require a server-side authenticated principal and block mutation if absent

title: Schema initialization accepts incomplete or failed databases
evidence: A database with only definities remains incomplete and executescript errors are swallowed
reproduction: Initialize a temporary partial schema and separately raise schema broken from executescript
recommendation: Use atomic versioned migrations and fail startup when required objects are absent

title: Service construction eagerly requires AI credentials
evidence: No-key service initialization fails before an AI flow and one dummy key is insufficient
reproduction: Construct the service with no keys then with only a dummy Anthropic key
recommendation: Create provider clients lazily and inject hermetic clients in tests

title: False-like strings normalize to true
evidence: Values false False 0 and no all normalize to True
reproduction: Call normalize_validation with each false-like string
recommendation: Use one strict boolean parser and reject unknown values fail-closed

title: Smoke tests use the default worktree database
evidence: Running the smoke file created data/definities.db in the execution worktree
reproduction: Run the smoke file from a worktree without that ignored database
recommendation: Use tmp_path fixtures and forbid the default database path in test mode

title: Document context is exposed in prompt debug and download
evidence: AppTest rendered DOCUMENT_SECRET_CASE_123 verbatim and exposed a download button
reproduction: Render a generation result whose prompt contains the sentinel document secret
recommendation: Disable production prompt debug by default and require an audited admin role with redaction

title: Definition text is written verbatim to debug logs
evidence: Cleanup logging includes the first one hundred characters of original and corrected text
reproduction: Trigger a cleanup that changes a sentinel definition and inspect debug output
recommendation: Log only IDs lengths and non-reversible digests

title: Raw internal exception details are shown to users
evidence: A RuntimeError containing a private path and token appeared unchanged in st.error
reproduction: Raise a sentinel exception from workflow or export and capture rendered errors
recommendation: Show generic Dutch microcopy with a correlation ID and log sanitized details server-side

title: Renders above five seconds bypass regression checks
evidence: The timing branch labels every render above five seconds heavy and skips check_regression
reproduction: Invoke metric tracking with render_ms above five thousand and spy on check_regression
recommendation: Classify by operation spans and retain an independent absolute UI watchdog

title: SQLite connections lack deterministic teardown
evidence: The connection provider has no close path and the green pilot emitted unclosed SQLite ResourceWarnings
reproduction: Run all pilot tests with resource warnings enabled
recommendation: Add close and container teardown then gate ResourceWarnings in tests

title: Smoke suite provides weaker evidence than claimed
evidence: The file claims ten tests but collects nine and contains an assertion-free validation test
reproduction: Collect the file and inspect assertions in validation and export cases
recommendation: Define functional smoke criteria and add hermetic behavioral assertions

title: Unused migration shims remain in the service surface
evidence: Base-tree reference search finds no production caller for freeze config and legacy surfaces
reproduction: Search every assigned symbol against the immutable base tree
recommendation: Remove proven dead shims in a separate controlled migration and consolidate contracts

title: Provider reset returns a stale process-cached adapter
evidence: After switching factory target old to new the same adapter returned the old container
reproduction: Populate the singleton cache then switch factory target without clearing SERVICE_ADAPTER_CACHE
recommendation: Remove the redundant cache or invalidate by config version and keep secrets session-scoped

title: Readiness feedback is contradictory
evidence: AppTest showed a missing-context warning followed by a different missing-category error
reproduction: Enter a term without context and activate generation in AppTest
recommendation: Use one readiness model with a disabled CTA and complete missing-requirement feedback

title: Heading hierarchy skips and reverses levels
evidence: Static inspection shows an h3 to h4 jump followed by h3 or subheader headings
reproduction: Render the component and inspect heading levels in source and AppTest
recommendation: Use one semantic heading ladder matching the visual hierarchy

title: Security events disappear from audit reporting
evidence: Blocked requests return local events but the persistent event list and report remain empty
reproduction: Submit a blocked XSS request then inspect response stored events report and export
recommendation: Record every event in one bounded thread-safe store before returning a response

title: Up to five ERROR validations are allowed
evidence: One through five ERROR results return allowed while six block and current tests encode permissive context behavior
reproduction: Validate requests with one five and six ERROR results
recommendation: Define the blocking policy then align severity names implementation and tests

title: Mutating feature routes would ignore sanitized request data
evidence: Middleware computes sanitized_data but forwards the original Request body
reproduction: Add an in-memory POST echo route and submit a BSN-like value
recommendation: Replace the ASGI body correctly or require endpoints to consume validated request state

title: Sanitizer levels are compared lexicographically
evidence: Moderate compares below permissive as strings and triggers stronger redaction at the permissive level
reproduction: Sanitize a BSN at every enum level
recommendation: Use an explicit numeric level ordering and parameterized tests

title: Email validation removes valid addresses
evidence: The valid-email regex is used as an empty replacement so valid input becomes empty and invalid input survives
reproduction: Sanitize user@example.com and not-an-email
recommendation: Validate with fullmatch and preserve valid values under an explicit invalid-input policy

title: Nested dictionaries in lists lose their type
evidence: List traversal does not recurse into dictionaries and stringifies the nested object
reproduction: Sanitize a list containing a dictionary with email and BSN fields
recommendation: Implement type-preserving recursive traversal for dictionaries and lists

title: Endpoint rate limiters contaminate each other
evidence: Every limiter reads and writes the same rate_limit_history file
reproduction: A limiter writes rate 7 then a separately configured limiter starts at 7 instead of 2
recommendation: Namespace history per endpoint and configuration and validate loaded values

title: Queue-time metric is never updated
evidence: The update helper has no caller and a processed queued request publishes zero average wait
reproduction: Queue and process one real request then inspect statistics
recommendation: Update wait duration when dequeuing before completing the future

title: Legal reference regex misses or corrupts citations
evidence: Multiword Wetboek names fail and the unbounded law-name pattern consumes following citation text
reproduction: Extract a multiword Wetboek and two legal citations from one sentence
recommendation: Use bounded non-greedy patterns with explicit lookahead and regression cases

title: Trusted-host predicate accepts substring-spoofed URLs
evidence: Attacker hosts and query strings containing trusted domains receive trusted status and bonus
reproduction: Check wetten.overheid.nl.attacker.example and an evil URL with rechtspraak.nl in the query
recommendation: Parse and normalize hostname then require exact host or real subdomain match

title: Mixed-case organization keys are unreachable
evidence: Static Reclassering and Justid keys cannot match an always-uppercase lookup
reproduction: Query every registered organization through the public API
recommendation: Canonicalize both keys and input with one casefold index

title: Four legal abbreviation expansions are broken
evidence: Mixed-case Sv Sr Rv and RvS keys cannot match uppercase input normalization
reproduction: Expand all five registered abbreviations
recommendation: Canonicalize the mapping and input identically with casefold

title: Geographic pluralia fail case-insensitive lookup
evidence: Lowercase input and prefixes are compared with title-cased set entries
reproduction: Lookup Nederlandse Antillen and Verenigde Staten in multiple casings
recommendation: Maintain a casefold search index and preserve original spelling for display

title: Classifier accepts semantically invalid AI JSON
evidence: Confidence 42 and garbage negative scores are accepted as high and reliable
reproduction: Return malformed but parseable JSON from a fake AI client
recommendation: Validate a strict finite response schema with bounded confidence and exact score keys

title: Definition validation ignores definition text
evidence: The documented definition_text never reaches classification
reproduction: Pass a sentinel definition through a spy and inspect the classify call
recommendation: Include definition text safely in classification or remove the misleading parameter

title: Cyclic and isolated taxonomy components disappear
evidence: Nodes are derived only from relation edges and traversal starts only at roots so a cycle-only graph returns empty
reproduction: Create A to B and B to A plus an isolated term in temporary SQLite
recommendation: Load all model terms and detect strongly connected and disconnected components before traversal

title: Migration rebuild drops generation prompt data
evidence: Replacement DDL and copy omit the canonical generation_prompt_data column
reproduction: Migrate a current temporary database containing prompt JSON and inspect schema and row
recommendation: Share canonical DDL or controlled column mapping and enforce schema and data postconditions

title: Failed destructive rebuild returns success
evidence: The migration commits before rebuild swallows copy and view errors and returns true with live definities empty
reproduction: Migrate a legacy row that violates the new category check
recommendation: Wrap the full rebuild in one transaction and fail or roll back on every postcondition error

title: Preference-term backfill is conditionally skipped
evidence: Backfill runs only when the text column is added while rebuild always removes the boolean source
reproduction: Migrate a database with nullable voorkeursterm and a true legacy flag
recommendation: Run idempotent backfills independently and verify results before dropping source fields

title: Migration integration test resolves the wrong project root
evidence: Migration paths resolve under tests/src and exists guards silently skip execution
reproduction: Run the file and observe two failures with migration files never executed
recommendation: Use a shared repository-root fixture and assert every migration path exists

title: SQLite backup omits committed WAL data but verifies successfully
evidence: copy2 copies only the main file and verification checks size and table names rather than rows
reproduction: Commit a row that remains in WAL then copy and verify the database
recommendation: Use SQLite backup API or VACUUM INTO and compare integrity and row fingerprints

title: Synonym uniqueness ignores per-definition ownership
evidence: UNIQUE group and term prevents the same scoped term for a second definition
reproduction: Sync one shared term for two definitions then replace the first definition terms
recommendation: Use partial unique indexes for global and per-definition scopes

title: Synonym synchronization commits partially after failure
evidence: Each registry operation autocommits on a separate connection during a multi-step sync
reproduction: Abort the second insert with a trigger and inspect the surviving first term
recommendation: Use one connection and transaction for group inserts and deprecations with full rollback

title: Production schema seeds invalid test definitions
evidence: Fresh databases always receive two sample definitions whose documented JSON context fields contain invalid JSON
reproduction: Execute schema.sql in a temporary database and parse every context value
recommendation: Move demo data to explicit test fixtures and initialize production schema without rows

title: Fresh schema contradicts migration version seven
evidence: Schema version remains empty and removed RAG count columns are reintroduced
reproduction: Create a fresh database and inspect schema_version and rag_collections
recommendation: Choose one migration strategy and make canonical schema match and record the latest version

title: SynonymRegistry leaks SQLite connections
evidence: Connection context blocks commit or roll back but do not close and nested calls amplify leaks
reproduction: Run six public operations with ResourceWarning capture
recommendation: Use a closing contextmanager and share one connection through nested operations

title: Dormant category migration fails on the current schema
evidence: It creates 26 columns then SELECT star copies 31 values and leaves a temporary table
reproduction: Execute the SQL against a current temporary schema
recommendation: Retire it as superseded or use explicit column mapping inside a rollback-safe transaction

title: Repository save ignores a failed legacy update
evidence: A false update result still returns the definition ID and increments success statistics
reproduction: Mock update_definitie to return false then call save
recommendation: Propagate a typed failure and update metrics only after a proven write

title: Hard delete confirms an uncommitted delete
evidence: The method returns true but the connection closes without commit and the row remains after reopen
reproduction: Delete a row then query it from a new connection
recommendation: Use an explicit transaction commit before success and verify rowcount after commit

title: Bulk update returns a partial count after rollback
evidence: The counter survives a later error even though the whole transaction rolls back
reproduction: Abort the second update with a trigger and inspect return value and both rows
recommendation: Return zero or raise a typed exception on rollback and test atomicity

title: Synonym repository leaks SQLite connections
evidence: Raw connection context blocks do not close and remain usable after method exit
reproduction: Run public operations with ResourceWarning capture and reuse the returned connection
recommendation: Use a real closing contextmanager and gate resource warnings

title: Reasoned history is not atomic with definition save
evidence: The definition commits before a separate manual history write whose error is swallowed
reproduction: Abort only the manualreason history insert and inspect definition and audit rows
recommendation: Write data and reasoned audit in one transaction and propagate failure

title: Sanitized AI errors retain the raw SDK cause
evidence: Wrapper text hides a fake key but cause and formatted traceback retain it and caller logs exc_info
reproduction: Raise a provider exception containing a sentinel secret and format the chained traceback
recommendation: Sanitize or sever raw exception chains at the provider boundary and test all log surfaces

title: Provider reset leaves singleton configuration stale
evidence: After environment switch a new container and router retain the old provider and key
reproduction: Switch provider in a subprocess reset containers and inspect manager container and router
recommendation: Use one versioned session-scoped config and atomically invalidate every dependent cache

title: Container singleton factories race during construction
evidence: Unsynchronized check-then-create returned two constructed instances in two threads
reproduction: Coordinate two threads between cache check and construction
recommendation: Lock creation or use explicit request or session scoped dependency injection

title: Container reset discards resources without closing them
evidence: Reset only clears dictionaries despite the AI client close contract
reproduction: Install close-spies then reset an initialized container
recommendation: Define teardown that closes every resource exactly once before clearing caches

title: Malformed provider responses escape consistent handling
evidence: Empty OpenAI choices raise IndexError while Anthropic non-text blocks return a successful empty response
reproduction: Feed both response shapes through fake clients
recommendation: Validate response shape and return one typed provider protocol error

title: Web lookup initialization failure is cached permanently
evidence: The first exception stores None and later calls never retry after the dependency recovers
reproduction: Fail construction once then make it succeed and call the getter twice
recommendation: Do not cache failures or use an observable retryable failed state

title: Shallow provider configuration merge breaks partial overrides
evidence: A partial nested providers override removes required sibling fields and fails at user action
reproduction: Construct the router with one partial provider section then request that provider
recommendation: Deep merge against a strict schema and validate at startup

title: Unknown models receive plausible default pricing
evidence: Any unknown model silently maps to default input and output prices
reproduction: Query cost metadata for an unregistered model
recommendation: Fail explicitly or expose cost as unknown without a financial number

title: Synonym registry fallback imports the same implementation
evidence: Try and except branches import the exact same class so fallback cannot recover
reproduction: Force the primary import branch to fail
recommendation: Remove the dead fallback or import a real compatibility implementation

title: Frozen DTO metadata remains mutable
evidence: Frozen dataclasses contain ordinary dictionaries whose contents can change after construction
reproduction: Construct a DTO then mutate its metadata dictionary
recommendation: Use immutable mappings or defensive deep copies and read-only return types

title: Critical interface defaults hide missing implementations
evidence: Base methods silently return false empty lists or none instead of failing
reproduction: Instantiate a minimal subclass without overriding the default methods
recommendation: Use abstract methods or fail-loud defaults and reserve empty behavior for explicit null objects

title: Conflicting canonical service contracts coexist
evidence: Statuses and result DTOs are duplicated elsewhere with incompatible shapes and callers rely on casts or duck typing
reproduction: Compare duplicate result and status definitions and their adapters
recommendation: Consolidate one contract module and add explicit legacy adapters and contract tests

title: Redis cache deserializes attacker-controlled bytes with pickle
evidence: Bytes returned by Redis flow directly into pickle.loads before the catch can prevent execution
reproduction: Return a controlled reduce payload or loads spy from fake Redis
recommendation: Replace pickle with strict versioned JSON or msgpack and retain Redis ACL and TLS as defense in depth

title: Cache identity and invalidation mishandle context variants
evidence: Semantically different requests collide and a context-keyed entry cannot be invalidated by the public method
reproduction: Cache requests differing in legal context instructions and model then invalidate one context variant
recommendation: Serialize every output-driving field canonically and use identical identity inputs for get set and delete

title: Document-only context is omitted from the active prompt
evidence: Source text appears in aggregate context but has_any_context is false so the orchestrator skips context awareness
reproduction: Build a source-only document context and inspect active modules and prompt
recommendation: Include usable sources and every context category in one presence predicate

title: Linguistic enhancement always fails with a regex replacement error
evidence: The replacement contains an illegal backslash-w escape and the coordinator swallows PatternError
reproduction: Enhance a sentence containing wordt and a sentence without a match
recommendation: Use a valid backreference or remove the unsafe automatic rewrite and test real matches

title: Later enhancements overwrite earlier applied results
evidence: Every strategy computes from the original text and full outputs are applied sequentially while metadata claims all changes
reproduction: Apply clarity and completeness together and inspect final text and applied list
recommendation: Recompute each step from current text or compose conflict-checked patches

title: Definition reconstruction drops domain and audit fields
evidence: Reconstruction copies only a few fields and loses ID context synonyms category validation actor and timestamps
reproduction: Enhance a fully populated Definition and compare every field
recommendation: Use dataclasses.replace and deep-copy mutable metadata with preservation tests

title: Completeness heuristic fabricates ungrounded facts
evidence: Keyword heuristics append definitive purpose procedure and scope claims without any cited source
reproduction: Enhance Vergunning Een toestemming at the default threshold
recommendation: Return review suggestions only or derive claims from cited context and revalidate them

title: Explicit nested generator configuration is overwritten
evidence: Post init replaces explicit Redis warning and false values with memory debug and true
reproduction: Construct UnifiedGeneratorConfig with explicit nested values and inspect them
recommendation: Keep defaults in field factories and modify only absent values without manual post-init calls

title: Prompt cap removes the term and final instruction
evidence: Blind prefix slicing truncates the final definition task after long document context
reproduction: Build a long prompt with a unique term and a one-thousand-character cap
recommendation: Allocate section or token budgets before assembly and reserve the mandatory task suffix

title: Raw term is logged before sanitization
evidence: The request term is logged before the security service returns its redacted form
reproduction: Capture logs while generating a dummy email-like term
recommendation: Log only generation identifiers before sanitization and redacted value or hash afterwards

title: Global prompt orchestrator leaks configuration between adapters
evidence: Constructing adapter B mutates the shared modules and changes adapter A output
reproduction: Create adapters with opposing metadata flags then build again with A
recommendation: Use an immutable per-adapter orchestrator or per-build execution context

title: Prompt include flags have no effect
evidence: All six flags false produce the same prompt as defaults with every supposedly disabled section
reproduction: Compare byte output for all-false and default public configurations
recommendation: Map flags explicitly to module activation or remove them and fail on unsupported configuration

title: Invalid RAG minimum score breaks generation without RAG
evidence: Unconditional float parsing runs before checking whether a RAG service exists
reproduction: Set RAG_MIN_SCORE to nonnumeric with rag_service none and generate
recommendation: Validate bounded finite config at startup and read it only when RAG is active
